book.name: 2 TIMOTIUS
book.title: SURANA PAUL TO RUA MPEARONA TO TIMOTIUS

content: Kadhaangiana Maanusia i Eona Aahirina Zamani
Udhania ande naile itu i eona aahirina zamani bheadhaangia tee wakutuuna kasukara.

Maanusia bhealabhiaka karona tee asintai doi. Manga incia bheabanggaaka karona, asomboaka karona, ahina mia mosagaanana, adorohaka tee mancuanana, inda amakidha apotarimakaasi, inda afaduliaka agamana,
inda apomaamaasiaka, inda amakidha apomaʼafuaka, amakidha afitanaa mia, inda amembali akuasai karona, amasega, abanci giu malape,
amenturu ahianati mia mosagaanana, amampodho fikirina, amalanga incana, tee alabhiaka kasanaana dunia tee amaasiaka Aulataʼala.
Manga incia atokamata mboomo mia motaʼatina moosena kaadharina agama, maka satotuuna manga incia o mia momendeuna kuasana agama. Sumaimo upekaridhoa o karomu minaaka i manga mia mboo sumai!

Roonamo i tanga-tangana manga incia dhaangia mopesuaikina bhanuana manga mia, kasiimpo ataangi manga bhawine tee kawuju tee katipu. Manga bhawine iwujuna sumai o mia indapo mokofikiri momatamona mpuu dosana tee ikuasaina pegiu-giuna nawusuuna,
tee sadia gauna bheapengkaadhari, maka inda amembali amatau kaadhari mobanara minaaka i Aulataʼala.
Apokana mboomo Yanes tee Yambres abhali Nabii Musa,
mboomo sumai manga guru gau-gau sumai abhali kaadhari mobanara. Fikiri tee iimanina manga incia amadhakimo.
Maka manga incia inda bheapotibhaaka opeopea roonamo kabhongo-bhongona manga incia bheamataua bhari-bharia mia, mboomo kabhongo-bhongona Yanes tee Yambres.
Iimanita Ajulu i nuncana Kasikisaa tee minaaka Tabaca Kitabi Momangkilo
Maka ingkoo padhamo uose manga kaadhariku, pemingkuiku, haejatiku, iimaniku, kasabaraku, kaasiku, tee katangkana incaku.

Ingkoo uka umataua manga kasikisaa, kanarakaa tee bhari-bharia giu mopadhana inamisiku i kota Antiokhia, i kota Ikonium, tee i kota Listra. Tapanamo kabhari o kasikisaa inamisiku, maka Oputa Momalanga apalapasiaku minaaka i bhari-bharia sumai.
Inciamo bhari-bharia mia gauna adhadhi asaalihi i nuncana sarona Isa Al Masi bheapotibhaaka kasikisaa
tee manga mia madhaki tee uka pande tipu bheajulu o kadhakina sabutuna manga incia apasaladhala manga mia, tee karona manga incia ahanda uka asaladhala.
Maka ingkoo tabeana usadhaadhaa udhadhi i nuncana manga giu mopadhana ipengkaadhariakamu tee uyaakinia roonamo udhania tee umataua manga mia moadhariko.
Tee uka roonamo uudhania wakutuuna umaidhiidhi ingkoo upomataumo tee Kitabi Momangkilo momembalina modhawuakako hikimati moumbaakana kasalaamati rampaakanamo iimanimu tee Isa Al Masi.

Bhari-bharia kaburi i nuncana Kitabi Momangkilo atoburi alaloi Rohina Aulataʼala tee akoguna to kaadhari, kaudhaniaka, to alape-lapeaka opea inda momalapena tee aadhariaka mia mamudhaakana adhadhi aose kapeeluana Aulataʼala.
Manga mia momembalina pewauana Aulataʼala padhamo atopamondo tee Kitabi Momangkilo sii to akarajaaka bhari-bharia pewau momalape.

footnotes.text: Yanes tee Yambres abhali Nabii Musa: I tulatulana miana Israel, rua miaia sii o mia mokoʼilimuuna sihiri mohambana Firaun abhali Musa mokosaroakana Yanes tee Yambres. (Kamata Limb. 7:11).
